ai.title: Agents at the Edge
ai.sub: We design and operate agent systems — model orchestration, retrieval and tool-use, evaluation, and the serverless infrastructure that runs them at scale. The mesh below is our actual runtime topology: a user prompt fans out to tools, memory, retrieval and the model, then loops back through guardrails before it ships.

focus.label: Agent orchestration
focus.text: Routers and supervisors that break problems into steps, hand off to specialist agents, and stream structured results back — observable at every hop.

focus.label: Tools & retrieval
focus.text: Function calling, tool use, RAG and memory that ground models in real data instead of guesswork.

focus.label: Evaluation & guardrails
focus.text: Evals, sandboxes and policy checks between the model and the user, so autonomy stays safe in production.

focus.label: Serverless LLM ops
focus.text: Durable state, queues and workers that run agent loops at the edge — scaling horizontally without operators.

focus.label: STEM-driven R&D
focus.text: Research-backed engineering: we formalize problems, prototype on the edge, measure, and publish what works.
